summary.name: Integrity
summary.one_liner: Integrity is a free link checker and website crawler for macOS that finds broken links on your website.
use_cases: find broken links on your own website
check large sites for link rot
check links on a corporate website
find expired domains linked from a site
summary.what_it_does: Integrity is a native macOS app that crawls a website and reports broken or bad links. The page describes it as very fast and accurate. It is positioned as a way to keep a site's links working to improve user experience and search engine optimisation. The free version has fewer features than the paid apps. Exporting data, logging in, managing multiple sites, sitemap generation, SEO checks, and spelling and grammar checks are listed as features of the related paid apps Integrity Plus and Scrutiny. Integrity is also available through the Mac App Store.
notable: Donationware: free for personal use with no restrictions, donations optional
Universal binary for Intel and Apple Silicon Macs
Older macOS versions (10.4 to 10.14) have legacy builds listed on the page
Paid siblings Integrity Plus, Integrity Pro and Scrutiny add more features
caveats: Free version has fewer features than Integrity Plus, Integrity Pro or Scrutiny
Requires macOS 11.5 or higher for the current version; older macOS versions need older builds
Business use is expected to purchase a paid licence
